Title: ​Accessing Library Resources While Away From Campus
NewsSummary: Library users are encouraged to login to access library resources remotely.​
NewsContent:
One of the hallmarks of modern libraries is the capacity to serve her clientele digitally and remotely. Even before this present darkness of corona virus disease (Covid-19) befell us, the library has been building capacity to serve users remotely.

There is however a studious joy that comes from sitting within the library space and the concentration and focus it avails for the researcher or student. The interaction with the librarian physically is also an added advantage as it allows for clarification of ideas and information queries presented.

While most people are adjusting to use of e-books and e-journals, the feel of the print book or document still impacts many and feels more like reading as opposed to reading materials online. The temptation to switch from serious studies to social media is so high that many a times readers would prefer to interrogate a physical text as opposed to a digital one. 

This is a discipline that many of us must learn and attain.

With the onset of Covid-19, and the consequent requirement for social distancing, ban on gatherings and the need for drastically reduced physical interactions, library services are equally impacted. The library wishes to assure all users that library services are however as available as it were previously, may be even more conveniently at the comfort of personal space, at home or in the individual office.

Users are therefore encouraged to access the library resources following the steps and guidelines given for continued studies and research. Library users are encouraged to login on https://vpn.ke.aku.edu to access library resources remotely.
